fact_text: WTI crude was about $86 a barrel on 21 Apr 2026, with the North Sea benchmark near $90, which the analyst uses as the base for grades such as Saudi Arab Light.

fact_text: The analyst cited the rupee at roughly 278 to 279 per US dollar on 21 Apr 2026.

fact_text: PSO is paying a large premium over benchmark prices on its diesel and petrol imports, which raises handling costs for oil marketing companies.

fact_text: The analyst said refineries' cross refining margins were already high, and under the current pricing formula they appear to gain more from the OMC import premium.

fact_text: On 21 Apr 2026 UBL had the largest deposit base among Pakistan's big commercial banks, which also include National Bank, HBL, MCB and Meezan.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: UBL's investments in government securities are larger than its deposits, so its bond portfolio exceeds the deposit base.

fact_text: HBL's government investments are also above its deposits, which the analyst said he had not seen for these banks before.

fact_text: The analyst reads banks' heavy government-securities holdings as an attempt to grow deposits, and says organic deposit growth comes mainly from branch banking.

fact_text: Bank Alfalah has the lowest market capitalisation to deposit ratio among the banks the analyst compared; Askari Bank was once second on that measure but has a higher ratio.

fact_text: The Special Investment Facilitation Council plans about $700 million of investment in cement plants, with Fauji Cement and Lucky Cement named among the existing producers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: The analyst converts the $700 million cement investment plan to about Rs 195 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: Pakistan cement consumption peaked at about 55 million tons in FY21, when cement makers' utilisation reached 80 to 90 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: Cement consumption in Pakistan has not exceeded about 45 million tons in the years since the FY21 peak of 55 million tons, per the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: On 21 Apr 2026 many cement makers ran at about 50 to 60 percent capacity utilisation, and weaker ones at 40 to 50 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: Fauji Cement and, to a lesser extent, Maple Leaf are the best utilised of the listed cement makers, with the two key northern players at about 60 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: The analyst links weak cement demand to budget constraints that limit public sector development spending, with Pakistan repeatedly turning to the IMF and other lenders.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: The policy rate is about 10 percent, and the analyst does not expect it to rise as had been predicted, which he sees as good for investment.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: The analyst puts the cement retention price at about Rs 700 to 800 per 50 kg bag, which he describes as a strong margin for cement makers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: The analyst says new cement capacity only makes sense if domestic consumption rises, because demand has stayed well below the FY21 peak.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: After the Attock Cement transaction, the analyst expects further consolidation among cement makers through mergers and acquisitions.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SIFC’s $700M Cement Investment & Lucky Cement! | Bank Alfalah & PSO | Midday Flash | 21 April 2026' (YouTube, 2026-04-21)

fact_text: Gwadar and Karachi handle most shipping traffic, which the analyst expects to create development opportunities for cement demand in the southern zone.
